Cupid led with 66% gains, followed by Sterlite Technologies and Welspun Corp, highlighting pockets of resilience amid market volatility.]]> </description><link>https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/10-smallcap-stocks-surge-up-to-65-in-3-months-despite-market-weakness/slideshow/135010857.cms</link><enclosure type="image/jpeg" url="https://img.etimg.com/photo/msid-135010752,imgsize-18310.cms" length="0"/><guid>https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/10-smallcap-stocks-surge-up-to-65-in-3-months-despite-market-weakness/slideshow/135010857.cms</guid><pubDate>Sat, 17 Oct 2026 14:16:40 +0530</pubDate></item><item><title><![CDATA[HDFC Bank Q2 Results: Net profit rises 5% YoY to Rs 19,510 crore; NII grows 10%]]> </title><description><![CDATA[HDFC Bank Q2 Results: India’s largest private lender HDFC Bank on Saturday reported a net profit of Rs 19,509 crore for the second quarter of FY27, marking a 4.6% year-on-year jump from Rs 18,641 crore posted in the same period last year.]]> </description><link>https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/earnings/hdfc-bank-q2-results-net-profit-rises-5-yoy-to-rs-19510-crore-nii-grows-10/articleshow/135010605.cms</link><enclosure type="image/jpeg" url="https://img.etimg.com/photo/msid-135010605,imgsize-191224.cms" length="0"/><guid>https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/earnings/hdfc-bank-q2-results-net-profit-rises-5-yoy-to-rs-19510-crore-nii-grows-10/articleshow/135010605.cms</guid><pubDate>Sat, 17 Oct 2026 14:16:36 +0530</pubDate></item><item><title><![CDATA[Crypto’s leverage machine finds new life beyond Bitcoin bets]]> </title><description><![CDATA[Despite a decline in crypto trading activities, there is a rising interest in traditional assets among investors. Open interest in real-world asset contracts has increased to $9 billion, claiming 14% of total volume. The transition marks a significant change in the derivatives markets as crypto inroads are being utilized for traditional trading. This shift indicates a maturation of the digital asset space, making it more accessible to mainstream investors.]]> </description><link>https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/cryptocurrency/crypto-news/cryptos-leverage-machine-finds-new-life-beyond-bitcoin-bets/articleshow/135007267.cms</link><enclosure type="image/jpeg" url="https://img.etimg.com/photo/msid-135007267,imgsize-193356.cms" length="0"/><guid>https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/cryptocurrency/crypto-news/cryptos-leverage-machine-finds-new-life-beyond-bitcoin-bets/articleshow/135007267.cms</guid><pubDate>Sat, 17 Oct 2026 13:57:30 +0530</pubDate></item><item><title><![CDATA[Axis Bank Q2 Results: Net profit jumps 38% YoY to Rs 7,003 crore, NII rises 12%]]> </title><description><![CDATA[Axis Bank Q2 Results:  Private lender Axis Bank on Saturday reported a net profit of Rs 7,003 crore for the second quarter of FY27, marking a jump of 38% from Rs 5,089 crore posted in the corresponding quarter of the previous financial year.]]> </description><link>https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/earnings/axis-bank-q2-results-net-profit-jumps-38-yoy-to-rs-7003-crore-nii-rises-12/articleshow/135009892.cms</link><enclosure type="image/jpeg" url="https://img.etimg.com/photo/msid-135009892,imgsize-106888.cms" length="0"/><guid>https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/earnings/axis-bank-q2-results-net-profit-jumps-38-yoy-to-rs-7003-crore-nii-rises-12/articleshow/135009892.cms</guid><pubDate>Sat, 17 Oct 2026 13:12:58 +0530</pubDate></item><item><title><![CDATA[F&O Talk: Nifty’s break above 23,450 could push index to 23,650; Sudeep Shah picks Tech Mahindra, TCS strategy]]> </title><description><![CDATA[SBI Securities’ Sudeep Shah sees scope for Nifty’s recovery if it holds 22,750, with IT, private banks and media leading. He flags key resistance levels, banking earnings, improving FII flows and continued large-cap outperformance, while warning that a durable reversal remains unconfirmed.]]> </description><link>https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/expert-view/fo-talk-niftys-break-above-23450-could-push-index-to-23650-sudeep-shah-picks-tech-mahindra-tcs-strategy/articleshow/135009790.cms</link><enclosure type="image/jpeg" url="https://img.etimg.com/photo/msid-135009790,imgsize-229140.cms" length="0"/><guid>https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/expert-view/fo-talk-niftys-break-above-23450-could-push-index-to-23650-sudeep-shah-picks-tech-mahindra-tcs-strategy/articleshow/135009790.cms</guid><pubDate>Sat, 17 Oct 2026 12:57:50 +0530</pubDate></item><item><title><![CDATA[8 small, midcap stocks with upside potential of up to 50%. How many are in your portfolio?]]> </title><description><![CDATA[PL Capital remains cautious after the Nifty’s eight-week losing streak, warning against expectations of a V-shaped recovery. Despite market uncertainty, the brokerage favours eight small and midcap stocks, including CESC, Amber Enterprises and Healthcare Global, citing potential upside of 13-50%.]]> </description><link>https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/8-small-midcap-stocks-with-upside-potential-of-up-to-50-how-many-are-in-your-portfolio/slideshow/135009761.cms</link><enclosure type="image/jpeg" url="https://img.etimg.com/photo/msid-135009633,imgsize-57922.cms" length="0"/><guid>https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/8-small-midcap-stocks-with-upside-potential-of-up-to-50-how-many-are-in-your-portfolio/slideshow/135009761.cms</guid><pubDate>Sat, 17 Oct 2026 12:40:01 +0530</pubDate></item><item><title><![CDATA[Nicholas Sleep’s investing lessons: Why patience, conviction and long-term thinking matter]]> </title><description><![CDATA[Nicholas Sleep’s investment philosophy emphasises independent thinking, patience, and understanding business fundamentals. His successful Nomad Investment Partnership demonstrated the value of identifying high-quality businesses, assessing sustainable competitive advantages, and focusing on long-term value rather than daily price movements. He advocated disciplined research, selective diversification, emotional control, continuous learning, and adapting decisions when circumstances change.]]> </description><link>https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/nicholas-sleeps-investing-lessons-why-patience-conviction-and-long-term-thinking-matter/articleshow/135009564.cms</link><enclosure type="image/jpeg" url="https://img.etimg.com/photo/msid-135009564,imgsize-2271601.cms" length="0"/><guid>https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/nicholas-sleeps-investing-lessons-why-patience-conviction-and-long-term-thinking-matter/articleshow/135009564.cms</guid><pubDate>Sat, 17 Oct 2026 12:38:15 +0530</pubDate></item><item><title><![CDATA[Concurrent Gainers: 15 stocks gain for 5 days in a row]]> </title><description><![CDATA[The Sensex gained 3.11% during October 12–16, while 15 BSE 500 stocks posted consecutive gains. Tata Elxsi led with 23%, followed by KPIT Technologies at 16%.]]> </description><link>https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/concurrent-gainers-15-stocks-gain-for-5-days-in-a-row/slideshow/135008981.cms</link><enclosure type="image/jpeg" url="https://img.etimg.com/photo/msid-135008866,imgsize-27906.cms" length="0"/><guid>https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/concurrent-gainers-15-stocks-gain-for-5-days-in-a-row/slideshow/135008981.cms</guid><pubDate>Sat, 17 Oct 2026 11:53:45 +0530</pubDate></item>
